newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Johnson Matthey downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Johnson Matthey downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Johnson Matthey slipped on Friday as UBS downgraded the stock to "hold" from "buy" and cut profit forecasts for the precious metals and speciality chemicals group.

UBS reduced March 1997 pre-tax profit forecasts to 110 from 119 million stg and 1998 to 124 from 136 million stg, after taking a more negative view on the outlook for the ceramics market, particularly the tile and sanitary-ware market in Europe.
Johnson Matthey shares slipped back 11-1/2p to 611p by mid-morning.
"There has also been a recent fall in the big growth markets such as China, Malaysia and Indonesia that is threatening overcapacity in ceramics," said UBS analyst Tony Lancelott.
